selected_example.selection_rule: maximize the number of distinct region-dominant scopes under mean soft allocation, then maximize mean pairwise absolute scope-forecast disagreement

panel_semantics.a: actual fused forecast; segment colour identifies the scope with the highest mean soft-allocation probability in that region
panel_semantics.b: each scope-conditioned forecast minus the actual fused forecast; all five rows use one shared deviation scale
panel_semantics.c: actual per-step soft-allocation probabilities for the same probe

claim_boundary: The selected validation example illustrates non-identical scope forecasts and region-dependent soft reweighting. It does not estimate prevalence, establish sparse routing, or demonstrate oracle scope selection or causal specialization.
